en.headline: About 20 evacuated after Mong Kok guesthouse fire
en.dek: Firefighters put out a blaze on the second floor of a Bute Street building shortly after 2am; one staff member was lightly hurt and refused hospital treatment.
body: A fire broke out in a guesthouse on the second floor of 38-44A Bute Street in Mong Kok in the early hours of Wednesday, prompting about 20 people to leave the building, including parents with young children.

Police received reports of smoke and flames at 1.53am. Firefighters arrived with one hose and a smoke team and brought the blaze under control at about 2.02am, the Fire Services Department said. The fire was fully extinguished two minutes later. A couple on the fourth floor also called for help; officers later confirmed they were unhurt.

A male staff member who was in a rest room suffered a minor injury while trying to put the fire out and declined to go to hospital after treatment at the scene. Fire officers said the blaze was believed to have started when a cigarette ignited bedding and other items. Police said there was no immediate indication of a criminal offence and no one has been arrested.

zh.headline: 旺角弼街賓館凌晨起火 約20人疏散一人輕傷
zh.dek: 消防凌晨兩時許救熄旺角利發大樓二樓賓館火警，一名男職員自行撲火時輕傷拒送院，暫無可疑。
body: 旺角弼街38至44A號利發大樓二樓一間賓館周三凌晨發生火警，約20人自行疏散到地下暫避，當中包括帶同幼兒及抱着嬰兒的住客。
警方於凌晨1時53分接報單位冒煙起火。消防其後出動一條喉及一隊煙帽隊灌救，約2時02分將火勢控制，兩分鐘後完全救熄。四樓一對夫婦一度報稱被困，消防員上門了解後證實兩人並無受傷。
一名男職員事發時在休息室，嘗試自行撲滅火種期間受輕傷，經救護員治理後拒絕送院。消防處表示，起火原因相信與煙蒂燃着床褪及雜物有關，現階段並無可疑。警方在場調查，暫未有人被捕。
